decisions.rationale: Align at objective level. Before P1's first use, add a minuted worked example plus check for the project-structure objectives it applies (file roles, component modules with imports/exports, development vs build). Before P3's first use on FT18, add one for response-driven list refresh and duplicate-submit prevention (create-edit-and-delete o2/o3). Rebalance build time inside the frozen 70-minute block. If a step cannot fit, narrow the increment to objectives actually taught, and remove those topics from its applied list. Do not rely on the Skim, the diagnostic or full topic pages.

Within S33's 80-minute Build block, add explicit, checked instruction on reconciling the screen with the response and guarding duplicate submission before P3 asks for them, or narrow P3 to the objectives taught there.
